review_notes.note: Native CJ at 3J explicitly prints 0514B2, A-C4G5; the A1 index has no matching portion, so the native literal is retained.

Printed identifier GJ at 1B, 0494D1/H2, all source card portions, physical pins and the four D13 wedges read directly. GH input D07 is washed but its remaining strokes were inspected at native size; no sibling label was copied.

FB and FF true outputs feed the DC/DH lower inputs and have two printed destinations LS821 with LS851/LS861 respectively. FD true output is independently routed upward to GC input. Four terminating resistor portions are offset to their printed ranks; crossings remain unjoined unless a diamond is printed.

Washed or locally interrupted but identifiable printing is normalized to visible wire glyphs and readable remaining lettering. Glyph continuity does not certify source electrical continuity. No connector table; title LAL 02 ◇ 03, LOG 153A, part 2585444, block GK and one revision retained.
FD/FF lower D13 endpoints and FH lower external-output bend are plain elbows, independently checked in native31/native32. Other native output diamonds retained.

Native page lettering, ports, printed wedges, diamonds, routes and footer reviewed independently. User-approved printer grid verified from printed grid labels, multiple native borders and local source character pitch. Independent root review pending.

All30 native blocks read including GJ1B0494D1, CJ0514B2/G5 A1 mismatch, varied3350D1/E1 inverter fields, four D13 wedges, blank AR T outputs/resistor inputs. All input origins Q/R02 RQ751AP4, E02RE701AV4, Q/R03RQ761AE4, L03RE701AP4; controls/terminations/offset resistors, reserved001-004 with separate legend stubs, P2LS991FD4 andP0DD4, native-feedback diamonds and both commoned latch outputs compared. True outputs FB4LS851+LS821, FF4LS861+LS821, FD4/FH4LS821 and four invertedLS821 outputs; title LAL02 diamond03,2585444GK/08-14-69/153A/08-08-69713380/no connectors compared. Three extra output bend diamonds corrected and independently rechecked. Full independent source and current complete preview comparison recorded in mid/takeover/low-crossreview/Independent cross reviews.json. Removed invented FD.D13 (178,27), FF.D13 (177,41), FH lower elbow (177,58) diamonds. Current production preview preserves remaining actual D10/D13/output junction diamonds and native plain bends.
